name: Youth Police Explorer Post 258
what_you_do: Teens learn about police careers through classes and hands-on training, such as building searches, traffic stops and crash investigation, and do community service.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 20. Needs a C average or better, a clean background check, and a parent okay if under 18.
deadline_text: Apply any time. New orientations happen every spring. Applications are kept on file.
how_to_apply: Download the application on the city page, sign it, and mail or drop it off to Champaign Police Department, ATTN: Youth Police Explorer Post 258, 82 E. University Ave., Champaign, IL 61820. Questions: Detective Michael Talbott, 217-403-6900.
notes: Members must go to meetings, keep a passing GPA and do community service.
